The Book of Deities contains an elaborate overview of the pantheon. By *using* it, you can opt for the belief in a deity.

The strength of a deity is determined by two factors: Its presence and its power. The higher the presence of a deity, the more attention it pays to the prayers of its worshipers and the more likely it is willing to return them from the threshold of death. To increase the presence of a deity you have to sacrifice gold to it at an altar. If a deity receives no oblations, its presence will fade until it is finally forgotten.

Every prayer is in vain, if the power of the invoked deity is not sufficient to do wonders. The power of a deity increases permanently. The higher its presence, the faster the respective deity gains power. A deity must have a presence of at least 10% to obtain power at all. If a deity works a wonder, it consumes a certain amount of its power reserves, depending on the type of the wonder.

To invoke a deity, use the command *prays* in the chat console. This can be particularly helpful, when you are badly wounded, affected by negative influences or to request the deities blessing before striding into battle. When you die, your deity can bring you back to life. Whether this succeeds, depends also on its presence and power. A deity grants favors as well as revivals only once in a certain time for the same person.
